1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with bold headings and comfortable spacing between lines and fields.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks appear anywhere; all copy is short sentence-case lines.

3.why: Content sits in a narrow single-column card with large text and a full-width button that reads well at mobile width.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.' are short and plain.

5.why: Every field shows a placeholder example (e.g., name@example.com, 07123 456789) plus a 'Demo:' example value beneath it.

6.why: No long text blocks appear on any screen; the longest content is one or two short sentences.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control appears on any screen and no long codes or secrets are ever displayed, as the flow stalls at step 2.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is visible on any of the four screens.

9.why: Fields are standard labelled inputs, but autofill or password-manager support cannot be confirmed from the screenshots alone.

10.why: A 'Step N of 6 · <name>' label sits at the top of each screen and a single large blue button marks the primary action.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one primary button ('Sign in and continue', then 'Confirm my identity').

12.why: Sign-in is confirmed plainly ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity.'), but the next observed action yields only the cryptic 'Invalid array length' with no plain statement of outcome or next step.

13.why: Retry is explicitly offered ('You can retry any step', 'You can correct and retry these details'), though no reveal/hide or re-request-code controls are observed.

14.why: The only error shown is the raw technical message 'Invalid array length', which neither explains the problem in user terms nor states how to fix it.

15.why: The UI explicitly states 'No reading timer. You can retry any step.' and no countdown or time limit appears on any screen.
